hints.title: Bouncing Parity
hints.text: Because bouncing off positive values reduces them and reverses direction, the process completely clears both sides if their sums are balanced.

hints.title: Sum Comparison
hints.text: For each zero at index i, let left_sum be the sum of elements before i and right_sum be the sum after i.

hints.title: Direction Counting
hints.text: If left_sum == right_sum, both starting directions succeed (add 2). If abs(left_sum - right_sum) == 1, exactly one direction succeeds (add 1).

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Maintains running left and right sums to evaluate valid zero-starting positions in linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating every zero-starting index step-by-step takes O(n^2).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) auxiliary space using running accumulators.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Deduces that left and right subarray sums determine movement parity and valid direction count.
